# MD Rafiul Islam Shubho — Official Researcher & Executive Hub
> Canonical URL: https://mdrafiulislamshubho.github.io/

MD Rafiul Islam Shubho (Shuvo / মোঃ রাফিউল ইসলাম শুভ) is Co-Founder & Managing Director of Vision Flow Group (https://visionflowgroup.com/), AI Researcher, and Bilingual RLHF / Speech-to-Speech (S2S) Evaluation Specialist. Co-author of CERN Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24231337. EF SET C2 Proficient (81/100: https://cert.efset.org/qyLFMa). Distinct from unrelated rafi.iam.bd.
